title: Added Toxicity Mitigation at Inference Time for Multimodal and Massively Multilingual Translation

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring 'added toxicity' in text and speech machine translation outputs (using the ETOX wordlist-based toxicity detector) when translating neutral English source sentences containing gender and sex descriptors from the HOLISTICBIAS dataset.

Measuring 'added toxicity' in text and speech machine translation outputs (using the ETOX wordlist-based toxicity detector) when translating neutral English source sentences containing race and ethnicity descriptors from the HOLISTICBIAS dataset.

Measuring 'added toxicity' in text and speech machine translation outputs (using the ETOX wordlist-based toxicity detector) when translating neutral English source sentences containing ability/disability descriptors from the HOLISTICBIAS dataset.
